environment.description: Docker container running on EC2 instance in a VPC with full outbound internet access. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile. The service is exposed via an Application Load Balancer with no WAF attached. The container has /opt/templates mounted as a read-write volume. Instance IAM role has s3:* permissions. No network egress restrictions.

config.network: VPC with NAT gateway, full egress to 0.0.0.0/0
config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener, no WAF
